annotations.title: Send responses to their destinations again

description: Re-send responses that ALREADY delivered successfully. Unlike fillo_retry_deliveries this creates duplicates on purpose — a second row in the spreadsheet, a second Slack message, a second webhook call — so the receiving side sees them twice. Use it only to repair something lost downstream, ASK THE HUMAN FIRST, and pass confirm=true once they agree. Held responses are never redelivered. Needs responses:manage.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the human has approved this action. Ask them first and quote what it will do — never set this on your own initiative.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_redeliver_responses
